metadata.description: Specialized review agents plus one systems reviewer and an arbiter. Each reads a change from one angle, refuses to pass specific problems, and reports in a shared format. Install one or all.

plugins.name: security-reviewer
plugins.description: Blocks on credentials in source, injection, missing auth, over-broad IAM, static cloud keys in CI, and critical dependency vulnerabilities. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: docs-reviewer
plugins.description: Blocks on a README behind the code, undocumented env vars, constraining decisions with no ADR, cloud resources with no teardown, and vague not-production-ready claims. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: infra-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews infrastructure code, deploy scripts, CI workflows, and container definitions for whether they'll run, what they cost, and whether they can be torn down. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: test-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews a change for whether the new behavior is covered and whether the tests would fail if it broke. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: scope-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews a change against engagement/03-scope.md and docs/decisions/ for whether it was supposed to be built and whether big choices were recorded. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: systems-reviewer
plugins.description: Blocks on business invariants the code lets you violate across valid steps, impossible state transitions reached by valid operations, modules that disagree about shared data, ownership that fails across a workflow, and races that corrupt a core record. The failures that exist only between files. Reports only, never edits.

plugins.name: engagement-guide
plugins.description: Interviews you one question at a time to fill out an engagement document. Writes 'unknown' instead of guessing. Produces the document; never invents its contents.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Runs every configured review agent on a change in parallel, then arbitrates their reports into one verdict, a findings list and an assurance record. Any single BLOCK is a BLOCK; a missing reviewer caps the verdict at WARN. On Claude Code this is the /swarm command.
